title: Ores Drop Op loot datapack
description: this datapack changes the loot table of ores and drop op items based on the rarity of ore
body:
💎 About:

Every ore in Minecraft drops custom OP items!
From Coal to Ancient Debris, each ore has unique themed loot — gear, potions, totems, even memes.


🧱 List of Ore Themes:

🪨 Coal – Starter OP loot⚙️ 
Iron – Diamond gear & XP💰
Gold – God loot + beacon💎 
Diamond – Full OP drops🔮
Lapis – Potions⚡
Redstone – Explosive tech🪙 
Copper – Builder’s gear
💚 Emerald – Villager treasure
🔥 Quartz – Nether energy
💀 Ancient Debris – Endgame god-tier


💡 Version: 1.19 - 1.19.3

⚙️ Pack format: 10

📦 Compatibility: Works in singleplayer + multiplayer

🎯 Made by: Modular Boy Ansh

🧨 How to install:
1️⃣ Download the ZIP
2️⃣ Put it in world/datapacks/
3️⃣ Run /reload
4️⃣ Start mining ores and get OP loot!
